pages.title: Immortal Embryo
pages.text: Always dropped by a $(thing)Hullbreaker$(), the giant of the Abyssal Chasm. It keeps the crew alive out there.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: The $(thing)Abyssal Chasm$() is an Alex's Caves biome deep under ocean, pitch black and crushing. A $(item)Cave Biome Map$() points to one. Go down in a $(l:ocean/submarines)submarine$(/l): it carries air, light and weapons.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Hullbreakers spawn there naturally, rarely. Underwater Mines and Depth Charges hit it from the safety of your hull. More will spawn if you need another.

pages.text: The road, and where this prize lives.
